title: Mo' Punkins
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 8 Punkins on the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 8 Punkins on the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Those darn Punkins! Inhabiting our farms and protecting them from our attempts to retake them.... It will not stand!

You will find them in the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag, that is where they have made their home. Slay these Punkins and return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

It appears that you have made it through the battle unscathed, well done. Let me know when you are ready to give this quest another go.

Objectives:

  • Slay Punkins

Level range: 80–85
